__NOTOC__
A '''crown''' is a ceremonial headpiece, often worn by royalty. There are several named crowns, as well as other places with "crown" in the name. "Crown" may also refer to certain [[Measurement#Coinage|coins]] such as an [[Andoran]] gold crown, and is also the name of a gambling game using coins.

==Crowns==
*The [[Rose Crown of Andor|Rose Crown]] - the crown of [[Andor]].
*The [[Broken Crown]] - the crown of [[Saldaea]].
*The [[Crown of Swords]] - the crown of [[Illian]], formerly the Laurel Crown.
*The [[Crown of the Tree]] - the crown of the [[Panarch]] of [[Tarabon]].
*The [[Diadem of the Daughter-Heir]] - the crown of the [[Daughter-Heir]] of Andor.
*The [[Diadem of the First]] - the crown of [[Mayene]].

==Inns==
*The [[Crown of Roses]] - an inn in [[Caemlyn]].
*The [[Crown and Lion]] - an inn in Caemlyn.
*The [[Golden Crown of Heaven]] - an inn in the [[Rahad]], near [[Ebou Dar]].
*The [[Goose and Crown]] - an inn in Andor.

==Others==
*The [[Crown High Council]] - a governmental body of [[Ghealdan]].

==Chapters and books==
*''[[A Crown of Swords]]'' - the seventh book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]''.
*''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 5|A Broken Crown]]'' - the fifth chapter of ''A Crown of Swords''.
*''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 41|A Crown of Swords]]'' - the last chapter of the book ''A Crown of Swords''.
*''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 43|The Crown of Roses]]'' - the forty-third chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
